KEN.note: Mentions digital-identity verification only as an approved parental-consent method in a bill; no service stated in use.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Online Safety Bill is not a data protection law; the Data Protection Act is mentioned only in passing, with nothing on standing, authority or application.
Nothing on ID operation or ownership.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.
Nothing on the national ID system.
No share of people using the internet given.
Nothing on public bodies sharing data.
A children's social media rule is not a cut, punishment or criticism fact for this study.
Mentions police only as a body to which abuse may be reported; no station records stated.
